scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c blue,yellow "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,server -c blue,yellow "npm run start -w web" "npm run start -w server"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server
